SELECT COUNT(*) AS ticks, MIN(tick) AS min_tick, MAX(tick) AS max_tick FROM ticks WHERE run_id=1

WITH latest AS (SELECT MAX(tick) tick FROM ticks WHERE run_id=1)
SELECT l.tick, l.*, b.balance,b.debt,b.treasury, m.population,m.arrivals,m.departures, p.demand_kw,p.supply_kw,p.outage_fraction,p.contract_mode, w.capacity,w.demand,w.load_ratio,w.failure_rate,
 c.avg_sat,c.employment_rate, r.avg_congestion,r.avg_wear, bd.avg_condition, bd.power_served_rate
FROM lever_monthly l JOIN latest x ON l.tick=x.tick
LEFT JOIN budget_monthly b ON b.run_id=l.run_id AND b.tick=l.tick
LEFT JOIN migration_monthly m ON m.run_id=l.run_id AND m.tick=l.tick
LEFT JOIN power_monthly p ON p.run_id=l.run_id AND p.ti

SELECT l.tick,l.income_tax_rate,l.property_tax_rate,l.electricity_tariff,l.road_maintenance_budget,l.water_sewer_capex,l.transit_fare,l.zoning_release,l.power_contract_mode,
b.balance,b.treasury,m.population,m.net,p.outage_fraction,w.load_ratio,w.failure_rate,
(SELECT AVG(congestion) FROM road_monthly r WHERE r.run_id=l.run_id AND r.tick=l.tick) avg_congestion,
(SELECT AVG(condition_score) FROM building_monthly x WHERE x.run_id=l.run_id AND x.tick=l.tick) avg_condition,
(SELECT AVG(satisfaction) FROM citizen_monthly c WHERE c.run_id=l.run_id AND c.tick=l.tick) avg_sat
